tools.name: freecad_command_list
tools.title: List FreeCAD Commands
tools.description: List statically scanned FreeCAD GUI commands with optional filtering.

query.description: Case-insensitive substring search over command name, menu text, and tooltip.

tools.name: freecad_command_describe
tools.title: Describe FreeCAD Command
tools.description: Return source-backed metadata for a scanned FreeCAD command.

tools.name: freecad_source_symbol_index
tools.title: FreeCAD Source Symbol Index
tools.description: Return a compact summary of scanned workbenches, command counts, and MCP tool families.

tools.name: freecad_source_search
tools.title: Search FreeCAD Source
tools.description: Search the local FreeCAD checkout for text matches.

glob.description: Optional filename glob, for example '*.py' or 'Command*.cpp'.

regex.description: Treat query as a regular expression.

tools.name: freecad_source_open
tools.title: Open FreeCAD Source
tools.description: Read a bounded line range from a source file in the local FreeCAD checkout.

path.description: Path relative to the FreeCAD root, for example src/Mod/Part/Gui/Command.cpp.
